name: binary_closure_parser

phase_0.boundary_condition: the file's own end (EOF): every claimed offset+length must close inside the byte stream; the binary is its own boundary and its own spec

VINIT.justification: the void before any header is named — nothing parsed yet

TANCH.justification: the terminal anchor: the magic seals the system, identifies the format, and makes the file's own spec authoritative

AFWD.chosen_element: forward parse of a header field
AFWD.justification: directed morphism: read a declared offset/length/pointer and advance the walk

AREV.justification: reverse descent: walk back from the structure model to bytes and compare

CLINK.chosen_element: composition of claims per the format's own rules
CLINK.justification: sequential chaining: sh_link chains, shstrndx references, section-to-string-table links

IMSCRIB.justification: self-recognition: the binary agrees with itself at every claimed offset

FSPLIT.justification: one binary branches into declared_structure (the model of claims) and raw_bytes (the untouched stream)

FFUSE.justification: re-fuse the declared structure with the raw bytes; reconstitutes the original input exactly when closure holds

EVALT.justification: affirmative branch: a claim does not close, finding with evidence chain

EVALF.justification: negative branch: every claim closes, no finding

ENGAGR.justification: a paradice held without resolution: anomaly present but exploitability contested (check-then-use, overlap, heuristic)

IFIX.justification: ROM fixation: offset, hexdump, CWE, severity written irreversibly to the report

phase_3.void_description: unread file — nothing parsed, no claims made
phase_3.true_description: T — confirmed structural anomaly with evidence (offset, hexdump)
phase_3.false_description: F — clean; closure holds at every claimed offset
phase_3.both_description: B — dialetheic; anomaly present, exploitability contested, held for triage

steps.domain_action: read the raw byte stream; nothing is named yet
recognize the container signature; the file's own boundary seals the system and names the spec
parse — the binary branches into declared_structure (the model of claims) and raw_bytes (the untouched stream)
walk the declared structure forward — headers, section tables, offsets, lengths, pointers
compose the claims per the format's own rules — sh_link chains, shstrndx, string tables
self-recognition — does the model re-fuse to the bytes? the closure identity fuse(parse(x)) == x
T — a claim does not close; confirmed finding with evidence chain
B — a claim is contested; held dialetheic for triage
closure check — re-fuse declared_structure with raw_bytes; reconstitutes binary_bytes exactly when closure holds
write the finding record — offset, hexdump, CWE, severity — irreversibly to the report

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the file's own headers — bytes are translated into declared structure by the format they carry
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: offset arithmetic — fields communicate through shared offsets into the one byte stream
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the byte stream itself — every claim reads at its declared offset
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: container order — header, then segment/section tables, then contents, then string tables
phase_5.alfs_store: the container format's canonical layout (ELF gABI, PE/COFF, Mach-O ABI)

phase_6.post_cycle_state: verified binary plus its verdict set
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the audit is read-only and deterministic; nothing is written into the target

banked_count_check.verdict: nothing was at risk: no clear ever fired against a live register, 3 deposit(s) made
